instrument_inflation_warning.why: its field was trained directly on USGS SGMC faults absent from the catalogue, which is the parent population of frame P, so its frame-P score is in-sample leakage and does not transfer.  The same hazard applies to this repository's own field: its in-sample frame-P credit per dot (0.4414) is nearly double the out-of-fold estimate from the blocked sweep (0.2267).  Only out-of-fold numbers may be used to choose a submission; the shipped file was chosen from the blocked sweep, not from its in-sample score.
